draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 223rd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 31st of 37 at CB. He went 167th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (223rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2021, 18th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 53 career games and 42 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 13 in 2023. Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 67.4% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
